scenarios.name: caller with runner set by hand passes doctor in a scratch repo
argv:
import subprocess,tempfile,os,sys,pathlib
gp=os.path.abspath(".story-gate/gate.py");d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
env=dict(os.environ,STORY_GATE_ROOT=d)
r=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,gp,*a],cwd=d,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
subprocess.run(["git","init","-q","."],cwd=d);subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@t","commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","i"],cwd=d)
r("install","--ci","reusable","--ref","a"*40)
p=pathlib.Path(d)/".github/workflows/story-gate.yml";p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("    with:\n","    with:\n      runner: ubicloud-standard-2\n",1))
out=r("doctor").stdout
print("doctor-says-ok" if "story-gate.yml           ok (SathiaAI/story-gate at v" in out and "runner: ubicloud-standard-2" in p.read_text() else out)
